story_zh: 小明只有一台旧笔记本。他每天上网看新闻和节目。昨天，他想发一封电子邮件给朋友，但电脑词典坏了。他只有修好词典，才能发邮件。现在，他正在用手机查单词。
story_pinyin: Xiǎo Míng zhǐyǒu yī tái jiù bǐjìběn. Tā měitiān shàngwǎng kàn xīnwén hé jiémù. Zuótiān, tā xiǎng fā yī fēng diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi péngyou, dàn diànnǎo cídiǎn huài le. Tā zhǐyǒu xiū hǎo cídiǎn, cái néng fā yóujiàn. Xiànzài, tā zhèngzài yòng shǒujī chá dāncí.
story_en: Xiao Ming only has an old laptop. He goes online every day to read news and watch programs. Yesterday, he wanted to send an email to a friend, but the computer dictionary was broken. He can only send the email if he fixes the dictionary. Now, he is using his phone to look up words.
